purpose: Static firmware investigation address inventory, not executable hook bindings
status: all candidates disabled; no live execution
address_space: Derived analysis virtual address; not DAT offsets; runtime mapping unverified

candidates.label: picture_address_setter
candidates.observation: Derived PIC address-field setter, layer 0 or 1; ctx+0xd4+layer*8.
candidates.limitation: Address value is not yet a frame lease.

candidates.label: picture_address_getter
candidates.observation: Reads ctx+0xd4+layer*8 into caller output, rejects layer >=2.
candidates.limitation: Pixel format, stride, producer ownership and cache coherency unknown.

candidates.label: picture_getter_wrapper
candidates.observation: Validates nonzero handle/output and layer, resolves display context, calls 0x122c6a0.
candidates.limitation: Logical display handle and active preview layer need runtime confirmation.

candidates.label: picture_setter_wrapper
candidates.limitation: Writes display state; observation breakpoint only initially.

candidates.label: picture_dump_candidate
candidates.observation: Reads PIC parameters/address, passes width*stride-like field*2 bytes to file-output candidate.
candidates.limitation: Diagnostic path writes files and waits; do not invoke for a read-only frame tap.

candidates.label: osd_address_setter
candidates.observation: Stores two caller values at ctx+0xc4 and ctx+0xcc.
candidates.limitation: OSD versus PIC roles derived from caller chains; no live buffer confirmation.

candidates.label: osd_update
candidates.observation: Selects surfaces, renders objects, configures OSD, alternates index 0/1 and commits display update.
candidates.limitation: Current task, locks, lifecycle and completion event require runtime tracing.

candidates.label: osd_render
candidates.observation: Clears current surface, traverses objects via 0x1248930 and callback 0x1246a1c, flushes, calls 0x13baa88.
candidates.limitation: Do not insert inference here; candidate observation point before completion only.

candidates.label: osd_configuration
candidates.observation: Routes descriptor+0x1c value through 0x121a028 into OSD fields; configures geometry and aligned width.
candidates.limitation: Descriptor field interpretation and pixel format remain inferred.

candidates.label: object_render
candidates.observation: OpenVG state/transform setup and draw-path loop, observed direct vgDrawPath call at 0x1248fe0.
candidates.limitation: No validated registration path for a custom object; preserve complete graphics state.

candidates.label: vguRect_export
candidates.observation: Name/function lookup record at 0x173379c; implementation requires graphics context.
candidates.limitation: Export availability is not an application render hook.

candidates.label: make_current_internal_buffer
candidates.observation: Named export; called by 0x1246f04 with 11-word attribute list terminated by 0x3038.
candidates.limitation: Mutates current graphics context and may allocate; not a preview getter.

candidates.label: query_frame_rejected
candidates.limitation: Helper reads surface+0xa0 then clears it. Not a passive camera-preview getter.

unresolved: Exact pixel format and channel order
